title: Ordinary scalar tensor associativity normalization
statement: the fifth equation of the parent statement This is a strict component of the canonical coefficient tensor normalization theorem.

proof.text: Prove the ordinary scalar tensorator on three factors on K-flat representatives using the fixed normalized comparison; the universal localization comparison descends the equation to all stated objects.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientTensor_normalization_scalar (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L] (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L), let SA := scalarIntegralClosed l E X let SB := scalarIntegralClosed l L X let F := integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X let μ := scalarClosedTensor l E L ι X ∀ K M N : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X), μ.hom.app (SA.tensor.obj (K, M), N) ≫ SB.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (μ.hom.app (K, M)) (𝟙 (F.obj N))) ≫ (SB.monoidal.associator (F.obj K) (F.obj M) (F.obj N)).hom = F.map (SA.monoidal.associator K M N).hom ≫ μ.hom.app (K, SA.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫ SB.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (F.obj K)) (μ.hom.app (M, N)))
